actual: Production read-only evidence on 2026-08-25: LocalSIM run simrun_a75b1c7f43167c32 repeatedly cycles SIGNAL_GENERATING -> PRE_RUN_FAILED with DAILY_TRADING_CONTEXT_PRE_CLOSE_QUOTE_INVALID and no broker side effect. market.stk_limit for 000019.SZ has pre_close=NULL, up_limit=7.06 and down_limit=5.78; TDX batch-quote returns K.Last=6420, whose documented raw-li price is 6.420 yuan. DailyTradingContextProvider compares the unscaled 6420 directly against yuan limits and rejects it. Each automatic scheduler retry re-enters selection inference during the execution window, causing avoidable DB/runtime churn instead of consuming one frozen daily plan. Preserve stk_limit as the sole up/down authority, normalize TDX raw-li exactly once at the source boundary, keep fail-closed freshness/coverage checks, and prove retry does not repeatedly execute selection/DB hot-path work after a successfully frozen context.
